text: Subjective: 30-year-old with asthma reports night-time cough and wheeze 4 times per week and uses rescue inhaler daily. Triggers include exercise and seasonal allergies. Objective: Mild expiratory wheezing on exam, peak flow below personal best, no fever. Plan: Step up controller therapy with inhaled corticosteroid plus LABA, provide written asthma action plan, reinforce correct inhaler technique, and arrange follow-up in 4 weeks.
